name: Cross-Tier Compute -> MQTT -> Docker Pipeline
description: Demonstrates Tier 1 (Termux compute/AI), Tier 2 (Debian 13 services/MQTT), and Tier 3 (Docker) collaborating as one seamless system using auto-injected PHONECLUSTER_* env vars.

steps.name: Step 1 · Run Inference / Compute on Tier 1
steps.command: python3 -c "import json, os, platform; print(json.dumps({'computed_on': os.environ.get('PHONECLUSTER_NODE_ID'), 'arch': platform.machine(), 'mqtt_detected': os.environ.get('PHONECLUSTER_MQTT_URL', 'none'), 'ha_detected': os.environ.get('PHONECLUSTER_HOMEASSISTANT_URL', 'none')}))"

steps.name: Step 2 · Relay Result via Tier 2 Debian Services / MQTT
steps.command: echo "Tier 2 ($PHONECLUSTER_NODE_ID) got payload from $PHONECLUSTER_PREV_NODE (T$PHONECLUSTER_PREV_TIER): $PHONECLUSTER_PREV_STDOUT" && if command -v mosquitto_pub >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -n "$PHONECLUSTER_MQTT_HOST" ]; then mosquitto_pub -h "$PHONECLUSTER_MQTT_HOST" -p "${PHONECLUSTER_MQTT_PORT:-1883}" -t phonecluster/pipeline -m "$PHONECLUSTER_PREV_STDOUT"; fi

steps.name: Step 3 · Inspect or Trigger Containers on Tier 3 Docker
steps.command: echo "Tier 3 ($PHONECLUSTER_NODE_ID) verified upstream step from $PHONECLUSTER_PREV_NODE" && docker ps --format '{{.Names}}: {{.Status}}' 2>&1 || true
